text:
Alice Chen: Quick check — planning a 45m evening "mini-runway" enablement for customers who can only do after-hours (EMEA/APAC friendly). Goal: fast intro + 20m Q&A + capture feedback. Thoughts?
Ben Rao: Love it. Lets keep it tight: 20m demo, 20m triage, 5m feedback form.
Priya Singh: Can we run it as hybrid: live + async recording + a short follow-up doc? Some customers asked for examples on Dedicated -> Private migration.
Maya Torres: I'm free to host Wed & Thu 5–6pm PT. Can do walkthrough of onboarding checklist + common gotchas.
Alice Chen: @Maya that's great. Need another host for the alternate slot (to cover EU morning). Any volunteers?
Ben Rao: I can take the EU-friendly slot (Thu 9–10am GMT).
Priya Singh: I'll prepare a 7-slide runbook and a 3-step migration checklist. Will drop in the channel.
Maya Torres: I'll also create a short demo repo link and a tiny sample prompt set.
Alice Chen: ACTIONS: 1) pick slot owners 2) create calendar invites 3) feedback form + follow-up doc 4) recording + repo. Who will create the form?
Priya Singh: I'll make the feedback form. Suggest 3 quick NPS-style + 2 open questions. Link when ready.
Sam (CS-Bot): Reminder: use the "cs-workshop-template" calendar invite so we get auto-tags in CRM.
Ben Rao: @CalendarBot can you reserve an org Zoom and add Redwood meeting room resource?
CalendarBot: Zoom reserved (zoom.redwood.com/meet/1759999999) and event created in org calendar. Invite will be sent once host emails are finalized.
Alice Chen: Cool — I pushed a draft agenda here: <https://docs.internal/repo/mini-runway|mini-runway agenda> (short bullets). Please add notes.
Maya Torres: Added demo steps and the troubleshooting checklist. Also added a tiny script to reproduce a common KV cache issue:
Maya Torres: ```bash
# repro script (run in dev env)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"repeat token pressure"}'
```
Priya Singh: Feedback form link: https://forms.gle/short-redwood-feedback (placeholder, will replace with company form).
Ben Rao: How do we collect renewal risk signals during the session? I'd like a quick poll mid-session asking "are you on track for migration this quarter?"
Alice Chen: Good call. We'll add the poll at minute 30 and a follow-up tag for CSMs to triage any "At risk" answers.
Sam (CS-Bot): @Alice adding triage tag workflow: create ticket in CSM queue when poll result = at_risk. Use tag #enablement-risk.
Priya Singh: For materials, I'll export slides + demo repo to the shared enablement folder after the session.
Maya Torres: One more ask — can we run a short pre-read for attendees (2 pages) so we don't need to cover basic concepts? I can draft.
Alice Chen: Yes please — pre-read + 90s explainer vid. Maya, Priya, Ben — assign owners: Maya pre-read, Priya form + post-docs, Ben EU slot + triage flow. I'll be host coordinator.
Ben Rao: Confirmed. I'll also add a calendar note for CS owners to follow up with accounts showing negative feedback.
Priya Singh: Form updated and shared. Added 2 open fields: "biggest blocker" and "next step preference".
CalendarBot: Event invites sent to customer list and hosts at 2024-07-18T00:05:00Z.
Alice Chen: Thanks everyone — we'll run a short dry-run Tue 30m before the first session. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're set.
Maya Torres: :thumbsup:
Ben Rao: :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
Sam (CS-Bot): Dry-run reminder scheduled 24h before first session.
